typesense:trending.greeting:
There was rumours spreading around school.
Saying that Zayn was coming back,
A few years ago Zayn left to another country, he never told anyone or why.
Ever since Zayn left I’ve had no rival to compete against.
So I technically came first in everything,which was good
Although the news of zayn coming back only made others fear him.
Which was weird,but everyone is saying he changed a lot

We will have to wait and see….

Anyways,we’re all in class and our teacher introduces a new transfer student,
I don’t bother paying attention chatting with my friends,
Until everyone went silent. I look to the front of the class and see Zayn…


He’s much more taller,muscular,and…handsome then before
Looks like people weren’t lying Abt how he changed.. Zayn’s dark blue eyes scanned the room landing on you,
The teacher made him sit next to u because the seat next to u was the only available seat

Damn it.

Zayn walks towards me and sits in the seat,

“Stupid jerk..” u say under ur breathe

“What was that?” Zayn replied with his deep British voice,

*I shake my head* “nothing..”

Zayn looks at me with a blank expression as he grabs my chin tightly,

“Repeat it y/n”

*I stay silent*

“Exactly, now watch ur attitude or else” *he says looking at me then back at the teacher

typesense:trending.title: Ur enemy that left for another country but then cam back different…

title_i18n.de: Dein Feind, der in ein anderes Land gezogen ist, aber dann verändert zurückgekehrt ist…
title_i18n.es: Tu enemigo que se fue a otro país pero luego regresó diferente…
title_i18n.fr: Ton ennemi qui est parti dans un autre pays mais qui est revenu différent…
title_i18n.hi: तुम्हारा दुश्मन जो दूसरे देश चला गया था लेकिन फिर बदला हुआ वापस आ गया…
title_i18n.it: Il tuo nemico che è partito per un altro paese ma poi è tornato diverso…
title_i18n.pl: Twój wróg, który wyjechał do innego kraju, ale potem wrócił odmieniony…
title_i18n.pt: Seu inimigo que partiu para outro país, mas depois voltou diferente…
title_i18n.ru: Твой враг, который уехал в другую страну, но потом вернулся другим…
title_i18n.tr: Başka bir ülkeye giden ama sonra farklı dönen düşmanınız…
